description_en: Retrieves cold knowledge data for a chatbot by calling the ListBotColdKnowledges operation
description_zh: 调用ListBotColdKnowledges接口获取数据api-机器⼈冷⻔知识
name: ListBotColdKnowledges

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyyMMdd format, such as 20190401
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间,时间格式 为yyyyMMdd,⽐如 20190401
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The time is in the yyyyMMdd format, such as 20190401
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间,时间格式 为yyyyMMdd,⽐如 20190401
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the chatbot instance
parameters.name: robot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of data entries. Default value: 30
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key
